verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs describe an orchestration layer where an external agent (Claude Code/Codex) claims a task, does the work, and opens a PR (foreloop-docs-3, foreloop-docs-4, foreloop-docs-7), but the actual implementation and test-writing is performed by the external coding agent, not Foreloop itself, and no evidence explicitly confirms tests are written as part of the flow. All evidence is vendor documentation with no hands-on or community verification.
